definitions.gloss: to cause, to give rise to, to trigger
definitions.explanation: To bring about an event, situation, or condition, often something problematic.

definitions.gloss: to help up, to raise up
definitions.explanation: To physically help someone who has fallen to stand up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不注意|ふちゅうい}→不注意：15111_fuchuui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{起|お}こした。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{副作用|ふくさよう}→副作用：05015_fukusayou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{起|お}こす⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This medicine may cause side effects.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{起|お}こして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The economic crisis is causing social unrest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転|ころ}んだ→転ぶ：00863_korobu⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{起|お}こして⟦あげた→あげる：00546_ageru⟧。
examples.english: I helped the child who had fallen get up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{倒|たお}れた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{起|お}こした。
examples.english: I picked up the fallen bicycle.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{年寄|としよ}り→年寄り：03460_toshiyori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{転|ころ}んでいた→転ぶ：00863_korobu⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{駆|か}け{寄|よ}って→駆け寄る：14681_kakeyoru⟧{引|ひ}き{起|お}こした。
examples.english: An elderly person had fallen, so I rushed over and helped them up.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive). Compound verb: ⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ + ⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧. Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{起|お}こす (cause X / help X up).

ASPECT: て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates ongoing situation or resulting state. {引|ひ}き{起|お}こして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ = 'is causing' or 'has caused.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{起|お}こす (cause a problem)
- ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{起|お}こす (cause an accident)
- ⟦{反発|はんぱつ}→反発：08676_hanpatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{起|お}こす (provoke opposition)
- ⟦{副作用|ふくさよう}→副作用：05015_fukusayou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{起|お}こす (cause side effects)

NOTE: Sense 1 (to cause) is much more common than sense 2 (to help up). Often used for negative events or consequences.
